title: InvisibleLight
description:
Allows you to obtain invisible light.
/light - Level 15
/light give (1-15) - grants the specified level
body:
A simple plugin designed to generate invisible light without using the /light command. It’s easy to use and requires no configuration—just install it and start the server.

Commands: /light -- emits level 15 light
 /light give (1-15) -- emits light at the specified level

To see the invisible light, you must hold a light in your hand. To break it, place any block where the light is located



(You can change it in Creative mode—specifically,but right-clicking in Survival mode does not work)

Requires Java 21 or higher
